name: Stanley R. Chesler
service_line_reviewed: Article III service reviewed: 2002–13 September 2026. Selected decisions: 4.

biography.text: Born in 1947 in Brooklyn. Chesler earned a B.A. from SUNY Binghamton (1968) and a J.D. from St. John’s University School of Law (1974). He was a Bronx assistant district attorney, a Justice Department organized-crime strike-force attorney, and an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New Jersey. He served as a District of New Jersey magistrate judge from 1987 to 2002 before President George W. Bush appointed him to the district court.
